items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Did you hear about Randy Weston and some other tall piano player came in and happened to be standing next to Wilt Chamberlain, and that reduced everything.

ctx.x: Did you hear about Randy Weston and some other tall piano player came in and happened to be standing next to Wilt Chamberlain, and that reduced everything. He’s tall, but there are taller folks than that.

Yeah. I don’t know if Wilt could even fit under a piano. Well, nonetheless, you’ve gotten some pretty high accolades over the years. And it’s a pleasure to talk to you. I’ve been looking at and listening to some of your recordings and reading about you. And first I’m interested — you’ve lived through some significant historical periods in America.
